get.description: The smallest free positive integer in the selected restaurant and kind catalog, encoded as a canonical decimal string starting at 1. Occupancy uses exact string equality: 01 does not occupy 1. The query is passive and reserved=false; no journal/stateVersion change. Manual opaque IDs remain valid; create performs the authoritative conflict check.

get.description: Human-authorized passive observation of a final-writeoff attempt. No append, expiry preparation or command retry. commandID and batchID reconstruct the original fingerprint. Compare the original saved Warehouse epoch before lookup; mismatch returns 409 RuntimeReset, outcome=indeterminate. Different batch for a retained command returns 409 CommandConflict and never reveals the original result. See backend-v2.md.

200.description: Typed passive observation; unseen is unknown, never proof of no commit.

default.description: Typed authorized failure; a GET transport failure is unavailable, never not_committed for the original attempt.

parameters.name: X-Umir-Runtime-Epoch
parameters.description: Original saved Warehouse runtime epoch. Mismatch returns 409 RuntimeReset, outcome=indeterminate before lookup; reused IDs in another epoch do not resolve this attempt.

ID.description: Opaque identifier. Unicode and reserved characters are allowed. Percent-encode query values; do not require UUID syntax.

ClientCommandID.description: Caller-generated command identity. Preserve the same value and identical input on retry. The expiration/ namespace belongs to warehouse.

PositiveInt64.description: Canonical decimal integer from 1 through 9223372036854775807. No sign, leading zero, exponent or fractional part. Keep as a string or BigInt in JavaScript.

NonNegativeInt64.description: Canonical decimal integer from 0 through 9223372036854775807. Preserve exact precision.

PositiveQuantity.description: Positive thousandths of the product base unit. "40000" is 40 g/ml/pcs; "500" is 0.5 g/ml/pcs.

Quantity.description: Nonnegative thousandths of the product base unit. "10000000" is 10 kg for baseUnit=g.

ShelfLife.description: day is exactly 24 physical hours. month uses the captured organization IANA zone, clamps the day to the target month end, chooses the earlier fold instant and first valid gap instant. Warehouse calculates and stores expiresAt once with applied settings/tzdata; exact replay never recomputes it. Duration/date overflow is InvalidArgument. This v2 rule does not change selected legacy contracts.

baseUnit.description: Optional assertion. If supplied, it must match the registered product. Omission lets warehouse obtain its base unit.

Dish.description: Immutable definition. Ingredients remain in recipe order. Each productID occurs once. Wire ingredients maps to serving Recipe and warehouse Ingredients.

RecordedDish.description: Definition stored in the event. Base units belong to ProductRegistered facts; history does not enrich or reinterpret recorded data.

DefineDishRequest.description: Creates a definition without replacing an existing dish. Ingredient productID values must be distinct and refer to registered products.

Deficit.description: Required and available quantities at this position evaluation. availableQuantity is less than requiredQuantity.

RequestedPosition.description: Input position. Serving assigns lineNo=1,2,... in array order. Repeated dishID values are allowed.

Position.description: Position with the original service-assigned line number. Do not renumber reductions or replacements.

Change.description: One reduction or removal. acceptedPortions is less than requestedPortions; zero denotes removal. Changes retain input order.

Allocation.description: Exact committed debit. Contains only recorded product/batch identity and quantity, without display enrichment.

Order.description: Authoritative recorded order. Wire acceptedPositions maps to serving Order.Positions and warehouse Order.AcceptedPositions.

OrderProposal.description: Immutable proposal; preparation does not reserve or debit inventory. Empty acceptedPositions is valid. Replacements use the preceding acceptedPositions as requestedPositions, retain lineNo and never increase portions or restore removed positions.

PrepareOrderRequest.description: Process positions in source order. An empty list produces an empty proposal. Do not send lineNo or an accepted composition.

ConfirmOrderRequest.description: Confirm only the saved accepted composition. Preserve both identities and the same JSON values after an unknown outcome. A replacement requires explicit user confirmation and a new commandID.

DeliveryLine.description: One source line creates one batch. manufacturedAt <= receivedAt <= operation time. Line numbers and batchIDs are assigned by warehouse; expiresAt is not caller input.

ExpiringBatch.description: Only positive prepared stock with expiresAt <= cutoffAt, sorted by expiresAt then batchID. Due expiry facts have already been applied. remainingSeconds=max(0,floor((expiresAt-evaluatedAt)/1s)).

Recommendation.description: One independently available portion. priorityExpiresAt is the earliest expiry among its actual FEFO allocations. Include each allocation at that expiry with its actual quantity; sort reasons by productID then batchID.

Menu.description: Dishes available for one portion, sorted by dishID. No available-portion count. Each dish is evaluated independently; this list does not promise joint order availability.

StopList.description: Dishes unavailable for one portion. Menu and stop-list complement each other only for the same evaluatedAt/stateVersion. Independent requests may capture different versions.

Recommendations.description: All independently available dishes, ordered by priorityExpiresAt then dishID. No urgency window or stock threshold.

ConfirmationPending.description: The original attempt remains unresolved. It does not establish a sale or terminal refusal. A different commandID must not start a competing sale.

ConfirmResult.description: Only the active payload is allowed. Unknown kind, absent required payload, extra inactive payload, wrong content type or malformed JSON is a protocol error. For a modifying request its outcome remains unknown.

ProductRegisteredEvent.description: Immutable journal fact. No nullable or unrelated payload fields. Replay uses recorded facts without recalculation.

DishDefinedEvent.description: Immutable journal fact. No nullable or unrelated payload fields. Replay uses recorded facts without recalculation.

DeliveryReceivedEvent.description: Immutable journal fact. No nullable or unrelated payload fields. Replay uses recorded facts without recalculation.

OrderPlacedEvent.description: Immutable journal fact. No nullable or unrelated payload fields. Replay uses recorded facts without recalculation.

BatchExpiredEvent.description: Immutable journal fact. No nullable or unrelated payload fields. Replay uses recorded facts without recalculation.

id.description: Stable opaque profile ID; not the login.

login.description: Immutable login identifier; it does not imply an email address.

displayName.description: Trimmed NFC display name of 2 to 80 Unicode code points.

OperatorSession.description: Session deadlines and the session's CSRF token. The session ID is never in JSON.

expiresAt.description: The earlier of the idle and absolute deadlines; equal to idleExpiresAt.

idleExpiresAt.description: Moves with authenticated requests of an ordinary session (30 minutes), never past absoluteExpiresAt. A remembered session has no earlier idle deadline.

absoluteExpiresAt.description: Fixed at login, 8 hours for an ordinary session and 30 days for a remembered one.

SignInRequest.description: Exact case-sensitive fields; unknown fields are rejected.

password.description: Sent as typed; never trimmed or normalized.

rememberMe.description: true opens a fixed 30-day session; activity never extends it.

currentPassword.description: Sent as typed; never trimmed or normalized. Outside an active cooldown and after newPassword passes field validation, a value over 32 Unicode code points is rejected before credential verification without consuming the failed-check counter or revoking a session.

newPassword.description: 8 to 32 Unicode code points; not trimmed, normalized or truncated.

OperatorError.description: Gateway-owned error of the account routes, the business-route guard and the feedback boundary, with Cache-Control no-store. Transport failures keep GatewayReadError and GatewayWriteError. Choose the user text by code and fieldErrors codes; message is for logs and developers.

message.description: Human-readable detail. Do not use it as a machine code.

fieldErrors.description: Only on 422; maps the rejected field to its stable code.

requestID.description: The ID the gateway also writes to its log.

sessionRevoked.description: Only on PasswordChangeRateLimited. true means this response revoked the calling session and stored the revocation; false means it revoked nothing. Never true when the revocation was not stored.

FeedbackSubmission.description: Owned by the umir-feedback service (umir-feedback#1); the gateway only checks that the body is one JSON object of at most 16 KiB. A non-empty website is a trap that answers a plausible 201 and stores nothing.

submissionID.description: UUID v4 generated by the client; repeat it with identical content after an unknown outcome.

name.description: Trimmed NFC, 1 to 100 code points without control characters.

email.description: A single unquoted address at most 254 UTF-8 bytes; only the domain is normalized to lowercase.

phone.description: Optional; digits, space, +, -, ( and ), with 10 to 15 digits.

message.description: Trimmed, 1 to 2000 code points; line breaks and tabs are kept.

website.description: Must stay empty; the form hides it from people.

GatewayReadError.description: Transport error generated by gateway or the frontend proxy. Received upstream status and body are passed through.

message.description: Human-readable detail. Do not use it as a machine code. Do not expose credentials or internal upstream URLs.

GatewayWriteError.description: Gateway or the frontend proxy cannot prove absence of a write after transport failure. Neither retries modifying requests automatically.

message.description: Human-readable detail. Do not use it as a machine code. Do not expose credentials or internal upstream URLs.

Instant.description: RFC3339 instant with seconds, valid calendar date and explicit offset. No leap seconds. Offset need not match the organization zone.

EntityID.description: Auth-generated canonical UUIDv4. Global identities and tombstoned IDs are never reused.

TimeZone.description: Loadable IANA zone. Auth validates packaged data; no Local/fixed-offset fallback.

RuntimeReadiness.description: Readiness for one explicit restaurant and service, bound to lifecycleVersion and exact peer epoch. Registry envelope restaurantID and runtime route restaurantID must agree with this value.

services.description: Exactly one entry per (restaurantID, service) for every affected restaurant and each of warehouse, serving, gateway. Unacknowledged peers are pending. No omitted or duplicate pair; lifecycle=deleted requires all closed in current peer epochs. See relational rules in backend-v2.md. Pending may omit epoch only when peer status is unavailable; that pair cannot satisfy ready or cleanup-complete.

LifecycleResult.description: operationID is an immutable UUIDv4 issued and persisted by Auth with acceptance, independently of opaque commandID. Exact replay and Auth command recovery return the same accepted result. Polling returns current peer readiness for that operation, including after scoped cutoff.

suggestedID.description: Canonical positive decimal suggestion; manual product/dish IDs use the separate opaque ID schema.

Suggestion.description: The smallest free positive integer in the selected restaurant and kind catalog, encoded as a canonical decimal string starting at 1. Occupancy uses exact string equality: 01 does not occupy 1. The query is passive and reserved=false; no journal/stateVersion change. Manual opaque IDs remain valid; create performs the authoritative conflict check.

DeliveryReceivedV2Event.description: Immutable journal fact. No nullable or unrelated payload fields. Replay uses recorded facts without recalculation.

LoginRequestV2.description: Exact case-sensitive fields; unknown fields are rejected.

password.description: Sent as typed; never trimmed or normalized.

rememberMe.description: true opens a fixed 30-day session; activity never extends it.

currentPassword.description: Sent as typed; never trimmed or normalized. Outside an active cooldown and after newPassword passes field validation, a value over 32 Unicode code points is rejected before credential verification without consuming the failed-check counter or revoking a session.

newPassword.description: 8 to 32 Unicode code points; not trimmed, normalized or truncated.

CompleteStockReport.description: Complete captured stock report for an organization summary: all rows collected from the same report identity, in page order. No nextCursor, page-size cap or silent truncation. Preserve context/page identity and all period/cutoff/coverage fields. A page failure makes the whole restaurant unavailable.

CompleteMovementReport.description: Complete captured movement report for an organization summary: all rows collected from the same report identity, in page order. No nextCursor, page-size cap or silent truncation. Preserve context/page identity and all period/cutoff/coverage fields. A page failure makes the whole restaurant unavailable.

WriteoffCommandLookup.description: Human-authorized passive final-writeoff lookup. Scope, epoch, commandID and batchID bind the canonical command fingerprint. A committed result is the original immutable confirmation result. pending and unseen remain unknown; only an owner-recorded rejected result proves not_committed. Epoch mismatch returns Error RuntimeReset/indeterminate instead of this schema. No final-writeoff record is exposed through Serving consumer.order.resolve.

LifecyclePeerReadiness.description: One affected restaurant/service pair. Pending includes epoch when current peer status is known; omit epoch if status is unavailable, never invent one. Ready/closed requires the exact current acknowledged peer epoch. Runtime register/close replies still require epoch via RuntimeReadiness.

oneOf.description: Unacknowledged restaurant/service pair. Epoch is supplied only when current peer status is known; unavailable status stays pending without an invented epoch.
Readiness for one explicit restaurant and service, bound to lifecycleVersion and exact peer epoch. Registry envelope restaurantID and runtime route restaurantID must agree with this value.
